what_was_measured: graded LLM-style extraction vs binary regex flags, as a residual channel

base_model.note: the lag block (surgeon x procedure history) is audit-verified time-honest; it alone beats the published full notes pipeline

residual_channel_on_2352_sampled_trainin.verdict: graded extraction is ~2.2x better than regex at predicting residual MAGNITUDE, but neither predicts residual DIRECTION, and neither improves MAE against a base that already contains the lag block

conclusion: the surgeon x procedure lag block absorbs most of what the clinical notes were contributing. The published +0.469 min note gain was measured against a base without lags.
